svg.title: How this site gets from a git push to your browser
svg.desc: A deployment diagram. On my MacBook, I write plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in VS Code, then git push. Self hosted at home in Docker on Debian Linux, GitLab takes the commit, Komodo sees the webhook and redeploys, nginx serves the files, and newt dials out. The connection crosses the internet through an encrypted outbound tunnel. On a Debian VPS, also in Docker, Pangolin holds the public address and terminates TLS, then serves your browser over HTTPS. No inbound ports are forwarded at home.
svg.text: From a git push to your browser

g.text: This page, however you got here.
